# AI Resume Builder

> AI-powered resume analysis and optimization. Upload a resume, get a deterministic score for any of 36 job roles, and download AI-improved PDFs in 10 professional templates.

Site: https://resume-constructor.vercel.app

## Pages

- [Home](https://resume-constructor.vercel.app/): Product overview, features, and getting started.
- [Sign Up](https://resume-constructor.vercel.app/signup): Create a free account to start analyzing resumes.
- [Log In](https://resume-constructor.vercel.app/login): Sign in to an existing account.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://resume-constructor.vercel.app/): Data is private and row-level secured per user.
